$jsonSchema.title: observation
$jsonSchema.description: One GHCN-Daily value: one station, one date, one element.

station.description: GHCN station ID, same as stations._id.

area.description: Copied from the station so area queries need no lookup.

date.description: Calendar date of the observation, stored as midnight UTC.

raw.description: Value exactly as in the NOAA file: tenths of degC (TMAX, TMIN), tenths of mm (PRCP), mm (SNOW, SNWD).

value.description: Converted value: degC for TMAX/TMIN, mm for PRCP/SNOW/SNWD.

mflag.description: Measurement flag, null when blank. P and T must not be read as ordinary zeros.

qflag.description: Quality flag, null when blank. A non-null value means the value failed a NOAA check.

obs_time.description: Observation time HHMM, null when blank.

file.description: NOAA file the row came from.

batch.description: batches._id of the import that wrote this version.
